Rank-4 JTDBCMFEXS3070309 (2025 Corolla Hybrid XLE, 17,289 dollars at Liz Auto Sales) passed through Erepairables.com, a marketplace for damaged vehicles, which points to an insurance total loss and likely salvage or rebuilt title, yet odo show printed Red flags (0). Evidence file is in the project home\\u0027s notes/. The flag is a warning only: whether such cars are excluded from rank is a separate ruling Brian has not made, so do not exclude them.
